title: GPU fleet lattice weeknote — Oct 3 2026
body:
Summary:
Weekly sync focused on the new "lattice" allocation prototype, regional preheat windows, and an ongoing tail-latency investigation in eu-west-1. Short meeting, lots of whiteboard sketches — this doc captures key observations, decisions, and next steps (including several small experiments to run during the next low-traffic window).

Highlights:
- Lattice allocation: prototype up and running on staging (nodes tagged with lattice-id, lightweight balancer routes). Observed ~6% higher steady-state utilization on mixed-load workloads in the Canary cluster. Initial win but fragility around long-running KV cache sessions.
- Regional preheats: implemented a rolling preheat window (03:00-04:30 local) for APAC edge pools; prewarm reduced cold-start tail by ~180ms on p95 for short chats.
- eu-west-1 SLO burn: two days of elevated retry-retries correlated with a specific backfill job that spikes memory pressure and triggers node eviction.

Metrics snapshot (week-over-week):
- Global GPU util (avg): 72% -> 74% (improvement attributable to lattice canary)
- eu-west-1 p95 latency: 420ms -> 610ms during backfill spikes
- APAC edge cold-start p95: 890ms -> 710ms after preheat test
- Spot reclaim rate (NA): 0.9% -> 1.1% (minor uptick)

Incidents & Root causes:
- Oct 1 03:40 UTC: retries in eu-west-1. RCA: unthrottled background backfill (job BACKFILL-1128) created sustained GPU memory pressure; autoscaler preemptively evicted several low-priority pods which cascaded into increased tail latencies. Mitigation: paused job and applied soft quota to backfill in region. Longer-term: add a per-region backfill circuit-breaker (JIRA-OPS-4127).

Experiments and notes:
- Lattice prototype details: routes by lattice-id -> route weight computed from historical token length distribution. Need to validate behavior with chat workloads that have long KV sessions. Current observation: KV cache leakage (some sessions holding >24h entries) reduces efficiency. Experiment: evict idle KV entries after 8h and monitor hit rate.
- Quantization canary: launched a canary with q4_0 for a small customer cohort on dedicated; CPU usage down, but slight increase in incoherent output for two prompts (see PR #986). Hold off wide rollout until eval team signs off.
- Backfill window throttling: trial throttling at 15% of node capacity reduced memory pressure but increased job completion time by 2x. Need tradeoff decision: faster jobs vs SLO stability.

Playbook updates (working drafts):
- Coldstart preheat templates: region-specific cron + priming payloads (short vs long). Draft in Confluence, need ops review.
- Eviction annotation: ensure autoscaler annotates evicted pods with evict-reason/backfill-job-id for faster triage. Patch queued (github #993).

Decisions needed / blocking items:
- Do we accept lattice as default for mixed workloads in staging? Vote in next triage: positive if no regression for long-KV chat tests. (Owner: Marcus)
- Backfill circuit-breaker spec: product impact assessment required (Owner: Tanya).

Action items and owners:
- Marcus: run 72-hour lattice stress with 20% long-KV chat traffic (start 2026-10-05).
- Tanya: draft circuit-breaker proposal + product impact notes by 2026-10-08.
- Jordan: implement idle-KV eviction policy (8h) in staging; measure cache hit-rate and latency p95 change (due 2026-10-07).
- Rae: update preheat cron schedules for APAC pools and share priming payload deck with SRE (done 2026-10-04).

Open questions / parking lot:
- How to surface lattice-id routing decisions in Console UI for customers using Dedicated? (UX + product design needed)
- Should preheat windows be region business-hour aware to avoid contention during maintenance?

Notes to self / scratch: 
- Slack thread #fleet-lattice has raw screenshots from the balancing microbench. Save them to Confluence before we delete ephemeral logs.
- Consider adding a slot-tiling visualization to the weekly dashboard — might help explain tiling inefficiency to non-ops stakeholders.

Meeting adjourned. Next sync: Monday 2026-10-11 09:30 PT.

Appendix (quick links):
- Backfill job: JIRA-OPS-1128
- Lattice design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/FLEET/Lattice+Allocation+Design
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/fleet-manager/pull/986, /pull/993
- Slack: #fleet-lattice
